directive.quote: For each, find what now does that job in trillion-rust or trillion-workshop, use it, and move the tool one to one under tools/.

old_copy.deleted_with: Old Worker retirement; current shared owners take the admitted host and records work.

preserve: Only words, title_fields and copy_state sections are selectable presentation.
Invalid, withdrawn, failed or stalled content is absent and private facts remain independently readable.
Optional presentation waits at most 250 ms and late completions never mutate the released answer.
Current rights are checked before and after presentation resolution; the private snapshot is taken afterward; settlement requests rawReceipt.
allowed_deltas: The host supplies current bootstrap rows and an admitted content-publication resolver instead of old Worker publication/database imports.
answerWithin is reused from its existing Workshop owner.
The private read is awaited so an asynchronous records-door owner works without losing the current-rights ordering.
The wrapper lives beside the existing keep-copies-in-step private owner instead of creating a duplicate catch-up tool.
banned_substitutions: Retired Worker account, control or database JavaScript imports.
A second live implementation of the sending, record or publication engine.
New runtime content persisted as source files.
